content: On the Hour, Level Three (the peripatetics) hold that only human spirits are held to account: the spirit is an immaterial substance, the site of knowledge of all things, and returns to its primordial origin once all things from pre-eternity to post-eternity have manifested in it.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
